entries.name: .NET MAUI
entries.use_for: Cross-platform native apps for Android, iOS, macOS and Windows in C#
entries.why: Microsoft official successor to Xamarin.Forms; the default for .NET teams building mobile apps.

entries.name: Capacitor
entries.use_for: Ship an existing web app as a native iOS/Android app with access to native APIs.
entries.why: Modern successor to Cordova; works with any web framework and keeps native projects editable.

entries.name: Compose Multiplatform
entries.use_for: Share Kotlin UI code across Android, iOS, desktop and web with Jetpack Compose.
entries.why: JetBrains framework that extends Jetpack Compose to iOS, letting Kotlin teams share UI and logic.

entries.name: Detox
entries.use_for: Gray-box end-to-end testing for React Native apps
entries.why: Synchronises with the app runtime to avoid flaky waits; the standard E2E tool for RN on simulators and devices.

entries.name: Expo
entries.use_for: Build, run and ship React Native apps with managed native modules, routing and cloud builds.
entries.why: Recommended way to start React Native apps; Expo Router, EAS Build and OTA updates remove most native setup.

entries.name: fastlane
entries.use_for: Automate iOS/Android builds, signing, screenshots and store releases
entries.why: The standard mobile release automation tool, used across native, Flutter and React Native apps.

entries.name: FlashList
entries.use_for: Fast, recycling list component for React Native, a drop-in FlatList replacement
entries.why: Shopify-built; dramatically smoother long lists, widely recommended for Expo apps.

entries.name: Flutter
entries.use_for: Build natively compiled mobile (and web/desktop) apps from one Dart codebase.
entries.why: Google-backed, own rendering engine for pixel-consistent UI and fast hot reload; very large package ecosystem.

entries.name: Gifted Chat
entries.use_for: Complete chat UI for React Native apps
entries.why: Drop-in chat screen with bubbles, input toolbar, avatars and load-earlier; saves weeks of messaging UI.

entries.name: Ionic Framework
entries.use_for: Build mobile-styled UIs for hybrid apps and PWAs with React, Vue or Angular.
entries.why: Mature mobile UI toolkit with platform-adaptive iOS/Android styling, usually paired with Capacitor.

entries.name: Lynx
entries.use_for: Write native mobile UIs with web-style markup, CSS and ReactLynx
entries.why: ByteDance open-sourced engine behind TikTok features; dual-threaded native rendering for web developers.

entries.name: NativeScript
entries.use_for: Build native iOS/Android apps in TypeScript with direct native API access
entries.why: OpenJS project; lets JS/Angular/Vue/Svelte devs call platform APIs directly without bridges.

entries.name: NativeWind
entries.use_for: Use Tailwind CSS classes to style React Native components
entries.why: The standard way to bring Tailwind to React Native/Expo; base of React Native Reusables.

entries.name: React Native
entries.use_for: Build native iOS and Android apps with React and JavaScript/TypeScript.
entries.why: The most used JS mobile framework, backed by Meta with the New Architecture and a large library ecosystem.

entries.name: React Native Calendars
entries.use_for: Calendar, agenda and date-marking components for React Native
entries.why: Pure-JS, customizable calendar and agenda views used widely for booking and scheduling screens.

entries.name: React Native Elements
entries.use_for: Cross-platform UI toolkit for React Native
entries.why: Long-standing, themeable RN component kit (buttons, inputs, lists, cards).

entries.name: React Native Firebase
entries.use_for: Native Firebase SDK bindings for React Native
entries.why: Modular, well-tested wrappers for Auth, Firestore, Messaging, Crashlytics and more on iOS and Android.

entries.name: React Native for Web
entries.use_for: Run React Native components and APIs in the browser to share code with web.
entries.why: Mature compatibility layer used by Expo for web and by large production web apps.

entries.name: React Native Gesture Handler
entries.use_for: Native-driven touch and gesture system for React Native
entries.why: Core dependency of React Navigation and most RN apps; gestures run on the UI thread.

entries.name: React Native Navigation
entries.use_for: Fully native navigation for React Native
entries.why: Wix library using real native navigation stacks and tabs instead of JS-driven ones.

entries.name: React Native Paper
entries.use_for: Material Design component library for React Native
entries.why: Callstack-maintained, themeable Material 3 components with good accessibility.

entries.name: React Native Reusables
entries.use_for: Copy shadcn/ui-style components into a React Native app styled with NativeWind.
entries.why: Brings the shadcn copy-paste model and look to React Native, built on accessible primitives.

entries.name: React Native Vector Icons
entries.use_for: Use popular icon sets (Material, FontAwesome, Ionicons) in React Native apps.
entries.why: The most used icon package for React Native, with many bundled icon sets.

entries.name: React Navigation
entries.use_for: Add stack, tab and drawer navigation to a React Native app.
entries.why: The standard navigation library for React Native and the base Expo Router builds on.

license_verified.note: MIT license files live in each package folder (e.g. packages/native/LICENSE).

entries.name: react-native-maps
entries.use_for: Native map views for React Native on iOS and Android
entries.why: The standard RN map component with markers, polygons and overlays on Google and Apple Maps.

entries.name: Reactotron
entries.use_for: Inspect state, network calls and logs of React Native apps while developing.
entries.why: Long-standing desktop debugger for RN with Redux/MobX-State-Tree plugins, maintained by Infinite Red.

entries.name: Tamagui
entries.use_for: Universal UI kit and optimizing style compiler for React Native and web
entries.why: Share styled components across Expo and Next.js with compile-time optimization.

entries.name: Taro
entries.use_for: Write once in React/Vue, ship to WeChat/Alipay mini programs, H5 and React Native
entries.why: The leading framework for Chinese mini-program platforms with React Native and web targets.

entries.name: UI Kitten
entries.use_for: Themeable React Native UI library on Eva Design System
entries.why: 30+ accessible components with runtime theme switching driven by design tokens.

entries.name: VisionCamera
entries.use_for: High-performance camera library for React Native with frame processors
entries.why: The standard RN camera library: photo, video, QR scanning and real-time ML frame processing.

entries.name: WatermelonDB
entries.use_for: Reactive offline-first database for React Native
entries.why: Lazy-loaded SQLite-backed DB that stays fast with tens of thousands of records, with a sync protocol.
